name: True Namer
body:
Prerequisite(s) 11th level Speaker, Namer, Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): You gain the Wizard arcane discovery True Name, treating your Speaker level as your Wizard level for all purposes.

Special: You can gain True Namer multiple times, but you must select a different, specific outsider each time.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
